repository.name: awesome_cybersecurity
repository.description: Open, curated and automatically indexed cybersecurity knowledge base: literature, papers and web resources organised by a CyBOK- and NICE-aligned taxonomy and published as machine-readable catalogs.

categories.name: Offensive Security
categories.description: Penetration testing, red teaming, adversary emulation, exploitation, post-exploitation, command and control and evasion tradecraft.

categories.name: Identity & Access Security
categories.description: Active Directory, Entra ID and Kerberos, authentication protocols, identity attack paths and identity hardening.

categories.name: Security Operations & Defense
categories.description: SOC operations, SIEM, detection engineering, endpoint defense, hardening, firewalls, logging and blue team practice.

categories.name: Incident Response & Forensics
categories.description: Incident response planning and playbooks, digital forensics, memory forensics, evidence handling and post-incident analysis.

categories.name: Malware Analysis
categories.description: Static and dynamic malware analysis, sandboxes, YARA, malware families, ransomware and threat hunting for malicious code.

categories.name: Reverse Engineering & Exploit Development
categories.description: Binary analysis, debugging, disassembly, OS internals, memory corruption, shellcode and exploit development.

categories.name: Threat Intelligence & OSINT
categories.description: Cyber threat intelligence, OSINT tradecraft, dark web research, MITRE ATT&CK, threat actors and intelligence operations.

categories.name: Application Security
categories.description: Web, API and mobile application security, OWASP, secure coding, DevSecOps and the secure software lifecycle.

categories.name: Cloud & Container Security
categories.description: AWS, Azure, GCP and Microsoft 365 security, Kubernetes and container security, cloud architecture and cloud penetration testing.

categories.name: Network & Wireless Security
categories.description: Network protocols and attacks, network defense architecture, wireless and Wi-Fi security, VPNs, DNS and service-level testing.

categories.name: IoT, OT & Hardware Security
categories.description: Internet of Things, industrial control systems and OT, embedded devices, firmware and hardware hacking.

categories.name: AI Security
categories.description: Security of AI and LLM systems (prompt injection, model abuse, AI red teaming, governance) and the use of AI in security work.

categories.name: Cryptography, Privacy & Anonymity
categories.description: Cryptography and applied crypto, privacy engineering, anonymity tooling such as Tor and Whonix, encryption and blockchain security.

categories.name: Governance, Risk & Compliance
categories.description: Security programmes and leadership, risk management, frameworks and standards (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS), policy, compliance, threat modelling and reference architectures.

categories.name: Security Awareness & Online Safety
categories.description: End-user security awareness, social engineering defense, scams, online safety for children and teens, cyberbullying and social media.

categories.name: Careers & Certifications
categories.description: Career paths and roadmaps, hiring and skills, study plans and certification preparation guides.

categories.name: Foundations & Systems
categories.description: The technical foundations security work rests on: programming and scripting, operating systems and administration, databases, version control, self-hosting and lab building.

categories.name: General Technology (out of scope)
categories.description: Technology content outside the security scope of this library (consumer hardware, gaming, personal finance and deals). Retained for completeness and flagged for curation review.

categories.name: Uncategorized (staging)
categories.description: Staging area for resources the pipeline could not classify with enough confidence. Every entry here is waiting for maintainer review.
